title: Condor Express Whale Watching

services.name: Wildlife tour
services.desc: Every trip is enriched by the presence of the Channel Islands Naturalist Corps, a team of knowledgeable experts dedicated to sharing the beauty of the Santa Barbara Channel. Onboard each whale watching trip, naturalists provide insight into the wildlife that call these waters home, help spot marine life, and answer questions along the way. From dolphins and whales to the unique ecosystems of the Channel Islands, their knowledge & insight transforms your cruise into an immersive and meaningful experience! services.name: Wedding Cruise
services.desc: Enjoy a taste of Hawaiian culture, sounds, and wonder 3,000 miles away from the sacred Hawaiian islands. World renowned musician Troy Fernandez brings the sights and sounds of Hawaii to Santa Barbara. Enchanted by his skills as a ukulele musician and singer, this cruise is a favorite of our passengers. Delight in decorations, light appetizers, a non-host bar, and Hawaiian leis on this night of music, dancing, and fun! Troy Fernandez, "Hawaiian Style Ukulele" celebrates the wonders of the tiny four stringed instrument as this world-renowned ukulele master will perform traditional and contemporary treasures along with his hula girls on board the Condor Express.
